known_limitations.description: The accept gate's strict-metadata check (specify_cli.acceptance.summary_core.build_work_package_state) requires a non-empty `agent` field in every WP's canonical runtime-state snapshot (status.json). WP01-WP03 carry "agent":"claude" (set via the real planned->claimed transition's --agent flag). WP04's lane history used actor "user" throughout with no --agent ever passed at any real transition, so its snapshot has no `agent` value and none was ever recorded anywhere on disk (frontmatter, event log, or otherwise).
known_limitations.investigation: Investigated three repair paths, all scoped to this mission, dry-run first: (1) `spec-kitty migrate backfill-runtime-state --dry-run --mission skills-behavioral-enablement-01KYJFAC` — direct inspection of read_legacy_runtime() confirms WP04's tasks/WP04-*.md frontmatter carries no top-level `agent:` key at all (only `agent_profile: node-norris`, a distinct field), so there is nothing to legitimately backfill; the one seed this command found is unrelated (WP02's tracker_refs annotation). (2) `spec-kitty migrate normalize-lifecycle --dry-run` — only regenerates status/progress/lifecycle projections, does not touch runtime agent metadata. (3) `spec-kitty doctor mission-state --audit` — 70 findings, none reference the `agent` field. Also confirmed structurally that `approved` has no self-loop transition (wp_state_for(Lane.APPROVED).allowed_targets() = {blocked, planned, in_progress, done, canceled}), so an approved->approved transition to carry a fresh --agent claim is illegal, and the only non-transition annotation seam that could set `agent` (emit_inner_state_changed) would require dating and attributing a claim event that never actually happened at the time WP04 was really claimed and reviewed — i.e. fabricating provenance, the same objection that already correctly ruled out unwinding the approval.
known_limitations.conclusion: No legitimate, honest repair path exists. WP04 was genuinely implemented and reviewed by an agent (see its approval note and T018-T021 subtask completion), but the CLI never captured that attribution because --agent was not passed at transition time, and there is no historical record anywhere in the mission's artifacts of what to backfill. Recorded here as a known limitation rather than fabricated. This is a real, currently-unresolved accept-gate blocker for a strict-mode run; `spec-kitty accept --lenient` bypasses the strict-metadata check entirely (this mission has not invoked --lenient, per the operator's instruction not to use --allow-fail/--lenient/--force).
